div.head: Had. 1
div.ab: Seofonfealde gifa sind Haliges gastes; and seofon stapas sindon ciriclicra gráda 7 haligra háda; and sifon siðan Godes þeowas sculon . . . hergan dæghwamlice on circan 7 for eal Cristen folc þingian georne.

Seven-fold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and there are seven steps of the ecclesiastical degrees and holy orders, and seven times a day should the servants of God praise God in church and intercede zealously for all Christian people.

Seofonfealde gyfa syndan Haliges gastes; and VII stæpas syndan cyriclicra grada 7 haligra hada; 7 VII syðan Godes þeowas sceolon God herian dæghwamlice on cyrcan 7 for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and seven are the steps of ecclesiastical ranks and holy orders; and seven times daily should God's servants praise God in church and diligently advocate for all Christian people.
